scientific_integrity: Proof uses a uniform fourth-power convexity inequality, geometric angular localization, endpoint lattice Laplace summation, and a separate finite numerical diagnostic. Published priority is assessed by scientific comparison, not certified.
scientific_limitations: The sharp statement concerns one fixed two-dimensional fourth norm and its exponentially damped polynomial lattice weights. Critical coefficient is for axis sequences; no global asymptotic maximizer, no necessity theorem for plain bounded Hilbert multiplication, no extension to all strictly convex norms, and no independent validation are asserted.
title: Sharp quartic spectral subconvolution threshold and its critical lattice constant
